text: dsh-agent-mailbox（DSH 插件）：把项目级 agent-mailbox 接入已有 DeepSeek Harness 会话。它在 DSH 的 tools 接口注册由后端授权的 MCP 工具，并保留各工具的参数 schema。主要功能是发现项目工具、转发工具调用、传递取消信号，以及在会话结束时注销工具并关闭连接。适合需要让 DSH 员工加入项目、使用项目协作工具的场景。使用前需要在本机运行 agent-mailbox，并为会话配置导出的项目 session 文件。

dsh-agent-mailbox connects project tools to an existing DSH session. It discovers backend-authorized MCP tools, registers their schemas, forwards calls, and closes the connection when the session ends. Configure a local agent-mailbox backend and exported project session file.
想让已有的 DSH 会话加入项目级 agent 信箱协作。
怎么把项目授权的协作工具接到 DSH 里调用？
希望 DSH 能把我提交的参数转交给项目工具并返回结果。
想在会话结束时自动清理已经注册的协作工具连接。
I want my existing DSH session to use tools authorized for a project.
How can DSH pass a project tool request to a local mailbox backend?
I need project tool calls to support cancellation when a session stops waiting.
I want dynamically discovered MCP tools registered with their parameter schemas.
dsh-agent-mailbox 的功能「工具发现」：激活时连接本机后端，读取其获授权的项目工具名称和参数 schema，再将可用工具注册到 DSH。
dsh-agent-mailbox 的功能「项目工具调用」：DSH 工具调用会转发为 MCP tools/call 请求；后端返回的文本内容会合并后交还给 DSH。
dsh-agent-mailbox 的功能「连接与生命周期」：每个插件实例独立启动后端进程；释放实例时注销已注册工具并关闭进程，调用还支持超时与取消。
dsh-agent-mailbox 使用前须知：需要导出的项目 session 文件及本机 agent-mailbox 后端；配置必须提供 sessionFile，后端以参数方式启动。

dsh-agent-mailbox README · dsh-agent-mailbox：Project-scoped [agent-mailbox](https://github.com/polaris-smart/agent-mailbox) tools for **existing DeepSeek Harness sessions**. Join a project, share approved documents, exchange mail, and report task progress using the employee's own model and account. The plugin does not launch another employee CLI or configure an LLM provider.

The executable is the installed agent-mailbox command/backend, not the DMG container. For a Python installation use `executable: /absolute/path/to/python` and `executableArgs: ['-m', 'agent_mailbox']`. Paths are passed as argument arrays, without a shell. Do not place keys or bearer tokens in this overlay, source control, or chat.

dsh-agent-mailbox README · v0.8 migration：Open a new DSH session with the overlay using your host's profile/patch workflow. Changes are not claimed to hot-reload an existing conversation. The workbench must remain open; restarting it on another local port is supported. Expired/revoked membership requires reconnecting/exporting a new connection.

dsh-agent-mailbox README · Tools and identity：At activation the plugin discovers the authorized `project_*` MCP tools and registers their actual schemas. Current v0.8 exposes context, shared memory/resources, inbox/reply, and assigned-task progress tools. No legacy global `mailbox_*` aliases, identity override, or managed-task wake tool is exposed.

dsh-agent-mailbox README · Tools and identity：The session file binds one employee to one project. Reading mail does not mark it accepted or complete. Ordinary messages do not start tasks. Human acceptance remains separate. Subagents report to their parent; do not share the private session file with them. Application support for automatic notification is separate from this tool bridge.

dsh-agent-mailbox README · Tools and identity：Each plugin instance has its own connection and lifecycle. Startup/discovery failures fail visibly; disposal unregisters tools and closes the child process. The plugin itself never reads the token or database.

dsh-agent-mailbox README · 从旧版升级：使用宿主现有的 profile/patch 方式打开新会话；不承诺现有聊天自动热加载。工作台须保持运行，重启更换本机端口后连接仍能找到它。会话到期、撤销或成员退出，需要重新接入。

dsh-agent-mailbox README · 工具与职责：激活时发现服务器实际授权的 `project_*` 工具及参数 schema。当前包含项目上下文、共享资料/笔记、收发邮件，以及自己的任务进度接口。没有旧 `mailbox_*` 全局别名、发件人身份覆盖或启动受管任务的唤醒工具。

一个私有 session 文件绑定一个员工与一个项目。读信不代表接受任务或完成；普通邮件不启动任务；Human 验收独立记录。子代理向负责人汇报，不得共享负责人会话文件。自动提醒是否可用取决于宿主能力，不是装了此工具桥就保证自动唤醒。

插件实例各自连接、各自释放；启动失败明确报错，卸载时注销工具并退出 MCP 子进程。插件不读取 token 或数据库。
